message.reasoning:
Strong report. Check calculations quickly: sun-sync inclination at 600 km ~97.79° correct. Launch azimuth: cos i/cos φ = -0.1355/0.9959 = -0.1361, β = -7.8°, fine. Period 5801 s correct. Ground track spacing: 2π·6378·5801/86164 ≈ 2698 km correct. Decay: Δa = 2π·(C_D A/m)·ρ·a² = 2π·(2.2·0.3/50)·1e-13·(6.978e6)² ≈ 2π·0.0132·1e-13·4.87e13 ≈ 0.404 m — correct. Sail: ×14.3 → 5.8 m, correct. Lifetime H/rate: 70 km / 2.2 km/yr ≈ 32 yr; 70/31 ≈ 2.2 yr — correct. Data budget: 60,000 km² × 40,000 px/km² (5m GSD → 40,000 px per km²) ×4×12 = 1.152e14 bits = 115 Gbit — correct. Downlink 50 Mbit/s × 2000 s = 100 Gbit — correct.

All requirements met. STK screenshots present, files listed. Minor: link budget missing (acknowledged), Vega C not flown (2025 launch, fine). Presentation excellent. Marks: C1 9, C2 9, C3 8, C4 9.
